# CE23-12 statistical acceptance rules

Every number below is kernel output (`pack/scripts/evidence_tiers.py`, exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson
at 95%, cross-checked against scipy and statsmodels to 1e-9); templates only render it. Standing is
typed by evidence volume and confidence, never collapsed into ALIVE:
N_discovery < N_qualification < N_operational < N_scale.

| tier | rank | N | nominal bound | exact bound, 0 defects | exact bound, 1 defect | rule of three | min n at 0 defects for the nominal bound |

| DISCOVERY | 1 | 30 | 0.1 | 0.095034 | 0.148596 | 0.1 | 29 |
| QUALIFICATION | 2 | 100 | 0.03 | 0.029513 | 0.04656 | 0.03 | 99 |

Reading rule: a zero-failure run is never read as more than its tier bounds. 0 failures in 30
trials bounds the failure rate only below about 0.10 (exact 0.095034): 30 unseen members per class
is first falsification, not evidence for 99% reliability. A class tuple states (class, n, defects,
confidence, bound, environment, factors, receipts); n counts distinct unseen subject digests, never
executions.

## First-crown thresholds (initial engineering thresholds)

| # | metric | rule | min n at 0 defects for a 95% lower bound |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | KNOWN classes qualified | >= 5 | - |
| 2 | unseen benchmark subjects per class | >= 30 | - |
| 3 | total KNOWN executions | >= 150 | - |
| 4 | false-KNOWN admissions | = 0 | - |
| 5 | LLM invocations on the KNOWN path | = 0 | - |
| 6 | human interventions | = 0 | - |
| 7 | unreceipted consequences | = 0 | - |
| 8 | tuple conservation failures | = 0 | - |
| 9 | mutation tests escaped | = 0 | - |
| 10 | cold replay divergence | = 0 | - |
| 11 | first-pass yield (FTY) | >= 0.95 | 59 |
| 12 | rolled throughput yield (RTY) | >= 0.9 | 29 |

These thresholds are point-estimate targets from the operator prose; after sufficient operational
observations the control limits come from the observed process distribution (SPC).

## Statistics definitions

| statistic | definition |
|---|---|
| FTY | units passing all k = 7 stages with exactly one ActuationStarted / N (unit = one admitted KNOWN work-order execution) |
| RTY | product over the 7 stages of Y_j = pass_j / n_j from StageCompleted events; RTY_unit = pass_all / N is also reported (equal to the product only under independence); Bonferroni lower bound 1 - sum_j p_U(d_j, n_j; alpha/k) |
| DPMO | D / (N * k) * 10^6, observed count (never a normal-approximation prediction) |
| P(false-KNOWN) | FP / (FP + TN) over expected-UNKNOWN B6 near-misses, with its exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound; safety-critical CTQ |
| p_U | exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound BetaInv(1 - alpha; x + 1, n - x); x = 0: 1 - alpha^(1/n); n = 0: 1; minimum n at 0 defects for a nominal bound p*: ceil(ln alpha / ln(1 - p*)); alpha = 0.05 |
| CPU | latency against a one-sided USL: sigma_w = MRbar / 1.128, CPU = (USL - xbar) / (3 sigma_w), Bissell 95% lower bound; Cp / Cpk only for two-sided continuous specifications |
| I-MR | xbar +/- 3 MRbar / 1.128; MR UCL = 3.267 MRbar |
| p-chart | pbar +/- 3 sqrt(pbar (1 - pbar) / n_i); LCL > 0 needs n_i > 9 (1 - pbar) / pbar |
| c / u | cbar + 3 sqrt(cbar); ubar + 3 sqrt(ubar / n_i); zero tolerance (cbar = 0) for LLM invocations, human interventions, unreceipted consequences, replay divergence |
| g-chart | UCL = gbar + 3 sqrt(gbar (gbar + 1)), conforming units between defects; used when pbar is near 0 |
| MSA agreement | effectiveness = correct / total; miss = bad accepted / bad (CP-bounded); false alarm = good rejected / good; repeatability = identical verdicts over r repeats; Cohen's kappa = (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e), defined only when both verifiers judged good and bad items |

## Evidence ceiling

- OS (UNSUPPORTED): only macOS 26.2 arm64 (Darwin 25.2.0) runs the executor; cached Linux images carry no Erlang/Elixir/Rust and no aarch64-linux NIFs; a Linux level needs an operator-approved image pull. Cross-OS robustness is outside the demonstrated evidence ceiling.
- repo size (PARTIAL): history contrast weak (26M vs 29M .git); tree size UNSUPPORTED (one registered format court suite, target_suites.ex:484). Promotion activates G=ACD: 2^(7-3) resolution IV, still 16 runs

Cross-OS robustness remains outside the demonstrated evidence ceiling: no OS level appears in any
run of the designed experiment and no cross-platform evidence is synthesized.
